purpose: Phase 4 English regression guard: re-generate representative English passages with the Pidgin-tuned weights to confirm the base model's English behaviour has not collapsed (README exit rule).
provenance: eng-001 is the verbatim Phase 1 test sentence (notebooks/02_first_generation.ipynb). The repo never stored a 5-passage Phase 1 list (scripts/evaluate_outputs.py was a stub), so eng-002..005 extend the same documentary/narration register used in Phase 0/1. Recorded 2026-10-21.

passages.text: The ocean covers more than two thirds of our planet, yet most of it has never been seen by human eyes.
The city library opens at nine in the morning and closes at seven in the evening, except on Sundays.
Our train leaves the station at half past six, so please arrive at the platform ten minutes early.
Scientists recorded a small increase in rainfall across the region during the last three months of the year.
If you feel unwell, drink plenty of water, rest, and contact your doctor before taking any new medicine.
